Definition: a Gederite, or inhabitant of Geder
BiblicalUsage: In Scripture, Gᵉdêrîy means a Gederite, an inhabitant of Geder. It occurs just once, in 1 Chronicles.
TheologicalSignificance: I take Gᵉdêrîy as it stands — a Gederite, an inhabitant of Geder — and read the passage with that plain sense in mind.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
